'''Lord Kyrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. He was tasked with the mission of destroying the [[Rift Alliance]]'s leaders before they returned to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He allied with the [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]] [[Augin Blaesus]] and together they captured the royal family of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]], but their plot come to an end when the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] arrived and killed Kyrus and Blaesus.

==Powers and abilities==
Lord Kyrus was a master of the lightsaber and was capable of the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] form in combat as demonstrated in his fight with the [[Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
